_comment: Donation channels. "image" = a ready-made donation picture in src/renderer/brand/ (e.g. a MoMo or bank QR card), shown as is. Or fill "bank" to have a clean VietQR code generated (showAccount=false shows only the code). Empty values are hidden; with nothing filled in, no donate tile or menu item shows. After editing run: node scripts/make-donate.mjs
